summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the formation of Z Studio, a new business unit for AI consumer applications. No transaction, special situation, or material corporate event is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of a business initiative with no deal terms, prices, or shareholder action. It does not fit any special-situations category. The registrant is the issuer reporting operational news. There is no risk-arb or structural angle; the event is merely a strategic expansion announcement.
